sections.title: Front matter

summary.text: Provides the header, footnotes, and link to WHO position papers for the December 2025 edition of Summary Table 3 on recommendations for interrupted or delayed routine immunization, noting that expert opinion supplements position papers where formal catch-up recommendations are pending revision.

sections.extract: Refer to https://www.who.int/teams/immunization-vaccines-and-biologicals/policies/position-papers for latest position paper updates. * For some antigens the WHO position paper does not provide a recommendation on interrupted or delayed schedules at this present time. When the position paper is next revised this will be included. In the meantime, some of the recommendations are based on expert opinion. ** See Table

sections.title: Table 3: Recommendations* for Interrupted or Delayed Routine Immunization - Summary of WHO Position Papers

summary.text: Presents WHO Summary Table 3 (updated December 2025) and its accompanying antigen notes (1–24), specifying minimum age of first dose, primary series intervals, rules for resuming interrupted series without repeating prior doses, catch-up regimens for children starting vaccination late (≤12 months versus >12 months of age), and booster recommendations across all 24 routine, regional, and high-risk antigens.
